mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is a pleasant 72 degrees with clear skies by the Military Ridge State Trail under a Full Moon.

The City of Verona has launched rebate programs for residents, including 100 dollars back for high efficiency toilets and 30 dollars for rain barrels to help manage stormwater. Also, don't forget to vote for your favorite student-designed I Voted sticker before the contest closes at midnight on August 7.
We have a busy schedule today with Yoga at Insight Wellness and Concerts in the Park at Century School Park. Also, join us for trivia at Hop Haus Brewing this evening.
In our weekly look at public safety, we noted that on July 21, a Verona Police Department drone officer assisted the Dane County Sheriff's Office in locating someone who had fled from a residence.

Today's delicious flavor is Caramel Turtle. While you are out, you can also catch Kona Ice at Fireman's Park from 12:30 PM to 4:30 PM. If you miss us, the store opens tomorrow at 10 AM, when the flavor will be Raspberry Cheesecake.
